--- SHEET NOTES ---
- This is a lightweight intake tracker intended to gate GPU allocations. Columns deliberately include both business and technical gates (activation_gate) so we can reject early if non-technical approvals missing.
- Preflight checklist items: cost estimate, SLA window, SRE checklist, security/KMS yes/no, data classification, expected throughput, fallback plan.
- Priority definitions: urgent (customer-facing demo/enterprise SLA), critical (latency-sensitive prod), high (large-scale experiments or scheduled rollouts), medium/low.
- Process: team submits request -> infra triage within 3 business days -> SRE/security review -> finance/BU approval if cost delta > $5k/mo -> schedule allocation or deny.
- Short-term heuristics for region placement: if team has >2 active prod requests in region, prefer colocated pools. If expected p50 latency > 80ms, prefer lower-latency region even if cost higher.

OPEN QUESTIONS / ACTIONS:

- (Finance) Confirm budget for REQ-2026-120 by 2026-05-30; if not confirmed, downgrade priority.
- (SRE) Define acceptable KV cache hit rate threshold to approve high-util requests (proposal: >=60%).
